turns.speaker: moshi
turns.text: Hi, how are you doing right now?

turns.speaker: user
turns.text: Honestly, a little stressed, but okay.

turns.speaker: user
turns.text: My closet is overflowing. I can't find anything in there.

turns.speaker: moshi
turns.text: A good sort will help. For the stuff you don't wear anymore, do you want to donate it, sell it online, or just store it in boxes for now?

turns.speaker: user
turns.text: Let me mull it over for forty-five seconds. Then ask me again.

turns.speaker: moshi
turns.text: Okay, time's up. Where are the clothes going?

turns.speaker: user
turns.text: Donate. I don't have the patience to sell stuff.

turns.speaker: moshi
turns.text: Easy and kind. Bag it up today and drop it off this week before it creeps back into the closet.
